name: com.clipkaboom/mcp
title: ClipKaboom
description: Search 5,500+ meme & reaction clips and preview them in chat, free. Clean HD/4K with a Creator key.

tools.name: search_clips
tools.description: Keyword search over clip quotes, shows, tags and transcripts (typo-tolerant). Best for exact lines, show/movie names or tags. Omit `query` to browse a category.

query.description: Words to match, e.g. a quote.

length.description: Clip length bucket: short (<~3s), medium, long.

include_thumbnails.description: Also attach the first 4 results' thumbnails as images, so you can see the frames before picking (costs extra tokens).

tools.name: semantic_search
tools.description: Find clips by meaning: describe the moment, emotion or reaction you need (e.g. 'someone slowly realizing they messed up'). Returns the closest matches.

include_thumbnails.description: Also attach the first 4 results' thumbnails as images, so you can see the frames before picking (costs extra tokens).

tools.name: similar_clips
tools.description: Clips similar in meaning/mood to a given clip.

id.description: Clip id (the `id` field of a search result).

include_thumbnails.description: Also attach the first 4 results' thumbnails as images, so you can see the frames before picking (costs extra tokens).

tools.name: get_clip
tools.description: Full details for one clip: transcript, description, typical uses, mood, downloads.

id.description: Clip id (the `id` field of a search result).

tools.name: trending_clips
tools.description: What's being downloaded most right now, optionally within a category.

length.description: Clip length bucket: short (<~3s), medium, long.

include_thumbnails.description: Also attach the first 4 results' thumbnails as images, so you can see the frames before picking (costs extra tokens).

tools.name: get_download_url
tools.description: Download link for a chosen clip. Free: the watermarked 480p SD MP4. Creator/Team: the clean, un-watermarked HD or 4K MP4 (4K falls back to HD when the source is lower-res), expiring in 10 minutes. Omit `quality` for the best the plan allows. Each call counts as a download: call it only for clips the user wants.

id.description: Clip id (the `id` field of a search result).

quality.description: sd = watermarked 480p (every plan); hd/4k = clean (Creator/Team). Default: the best allowed.
